'''2026 Retro World Championship''' was the Players Committee's Retro ([[Premiere - Death Star II]]) championship held alongside the [[2026 World Championship]] in Bloomington, Minnesota, in October 2026.<ref name="sched">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86982 Schedule of Events (2026 World Championship)], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum</ref> The Players Committee posted the Dark and Light Side lists of four players on 2 November 2026: [[Jeremy Christoffel]], [[Alex Prodoehl]], [[Zach Stenerson]] and [[Will Tarbox]].<ref name="posts">Deck posts listed under Sources, starwarsccg.org (2 November 2026).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' Bloomington, Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 23–25 October 2026 (World Championship weekend)<ref name="sched" />
